# sreagent_outbound_rules (Data Source)

Every outbound_rule row, read-only. Which alerts page which outbound target, and when.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_outbound_rules" "all" {}

output "outbound_rules_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_outbound_rules.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minimum minutes between pages from this rule; unset means 30.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is in force.
- `escalate_after_minutes` (Number) Page only when the alert is still unacknowledged after this many minutes.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `last_triggered_at` (String) When the rule last paged.
- `match_labels` (String) Only alerts carrying these labels, as jsonencode({...}). Unset matches every alert.
- `match_severity` (String) Only alerts at this severity.
- `match_source` (String) Only alerts from this source.
- `name` (String) Unique within the organization.
- `outbound_config_id` (String) The target this rule pages.
- `outbound_config_name` (String) The target's name.
- `step_order` (Number) This rule's step in an escalation chain; unset means 0, the first step.
